messages:
Ana: quick flag — seeing ~12% of inbound HubSpot leads remain UNCLAIMED past 10m in the last 24h. Pattern looks correlated with enrichment spikes. cc @Devon @Mari — can we triage? link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/filter/claim-unacked :eyes:
Devon: on it. do we know if these are evenly distributed or concentrated by connector/region? any recent RR (round-robin) changes?
Mari: i pulled the filter and sample IDs. most are from EU APAC connectors and a couple from our webhook retry window. noticed enrichment API 429s around 2024-06-17T03:12Z which coincides. also noticed rr slot timeouts look short.
Kevin: what's the business impact? are VIP leads included in the 12%? if yes we should bypass RR for VIPs asap.
HubSpot Bot: webhook retries 502/504 spikes recorded 2024-06-17T03:10:57 - 03:18:10 (20 failures). reference: hs-webhook-logs/2024-06-17
Evan: sales note — a few reps pinged me that leads show as "unassigned" in HS even though they tried to claim. sounds like ack window closes before owner is provisioned in SF.
Mari: quick config snapshot from our round-robin service (current):
```
{\n  "round_robin": true,\n  "slot_timeout_seconds": 20,\n  "ack_window_seconds": 10,\n  "prewarm_enrichment": false\n}
```
I think the ack_window=10s is too tight given enrichment latency spikes + webhook retries. we should increase ack_window and enable prewarm_enrichment for connectors that call external APIs.
Devon: agreed. proposed short-term actions:
- increase ack_window to 60s (canary 10% traffic)
- add a heartbeat metric and pager if lead remains unclaimed at 5m
- temporary VIP bypass to Dedicated pool for high-intent leads
I'll open a PR and roll a canary.
Kevin: +1 for VIP bypass. also suggest we add an SLA metric to marketing dashboard (pct claimed <10m) so we can watch in real-time.
Mari: i'll update HS workflow to extend "claim grace" and add fallback owner for unclaimed after 8m. will coordinate mapping with SF connector.
Evan: pls also add a slack notify to #sales when a VIP goes unclaimed at 5m — that reduces missed follow-ups.
Devon: quick diagnostic to run (bq):
```
SELECT lead_id, created_at, enrichment_time_ms, rr_slot_claim_time_ms
FROM `prod.marketing.inbound_leads`
WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND claimed_at IS NULL
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
This will help isolate if rr_slot_claim_time is > ack_window.
Ana: nice — thanks team. owners: Devon (canary + heartbeat + PR), Mari (HS workflow + fallback owner), Kevin (dashboard + VIP bypass approval), Evan (sales notify playbook). I'll schedule a 30m sync after canary is live. :calendar:
Devon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/leadrouter/pull/482 — canary target 10% starting at 1718812400. will post status here when traffic ramps. :rocket:
Ana: great. once canary proves stable we'll set rollback criteria (if pct unclaimed at 10m increases or enrichment 429s recur). thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
